title: Trump to impose double-digit tariffs on dozens of countries
script: Here is a fast update on a developing story. Reports are focusing on this development: Trump to impose double-digit tariffs on dozens of countries. In simple words, The United States will slap taxes of 10% to 12.5% on imports from 60 countries accounting for 99% of U.S. imports, charging that they have inadequately enforced bans on goods produced by forced labor Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update. This is a developing story, and verified details may change later.
